verdict.rationale: Weaviate's own docs describe built-in BM25 keyword search alongside vector search, and the llms.txt probe confirms it stores inverted indexes natively. Full-text search therefore runs inside the database rather than in a separate search engine. missing for 10: explicit documentation of standalone BM25/keyword-only queries (evidence centers on hybrid), tokenization/analyzer configuration details, independent hands-on corroboration of keyword search quality

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine

citations.quote: Hybrid search combines vector search and keyword search (BM25) to leverage the strengths of both approaches.
By indexing data with vectors, Weaviate supports searches based on both semantic similarity and keywords.
Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
A hybrid search runs both search types in parallel and combines their scores to produce a final ranking of results.
